title: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL no longer fall back to a fake soccer bracket
items: The Bracket tab isn't currently shown in the sidebar for these four leagues, but the underlying render path was still reachable and, like the CFP bracket before it, would have silently shown the same fake 32-team World Cup group-into-knockout shape — built from standings data that isn't even grouped for these sports, since nothing computes real NFL wild-card, NBA/NHL conference-bracket, or MLB Division/Championship Series seeding. It now shows an honest "not built yet" message instead of a wrong bracket.
